transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, I came in because I'm having a problem with my eating. It happens mostly at night. After everyone goes to bed, I’ll tell myself I’m just going to have a few leftovers. 

But then... I don't know, I'll suddenly realize I’ve eaten half a tray of catered pasta from work, the dessert from a client dinner, and just whatever snacks were in the pantry, all in one sitting. It's getting out of hand, and I need to figure out how to stop.
When this happens, do you feel unable to stop eating or control how much you’re eating?

Yeah, that's exactly it. Once I start... well, especially if it's been a tense night with my husband, it feels like the decision-making part of me just goes completely offline. I'll keep reaching for more food, even while I'm sitting there thinking to myself, 'Patricia, stop, this is enough.' But I just can't seem to make myself stop.
After these eating episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit?
No, I don't do that. I've never tried to make myself throw up or anything like that. I just sort of sit there feeling awful and overly full.
During these episodes, do you eat an unusually large amount of food for the situation?

Yes, definitely. Like I mentioned a few minutes ago, it's a really large amount of food. I'll go into the kitchen thinking I'm just having a normal bite of leftovers, but I end up eating half a tray of that catered pasta, a whole dessert from a work dinner, and whatever else is in the pantry, all at the same time. So, yes, it's way more than anyone would normally eat for a late-night snack.
Do these eating episodes cause you a lot of distress?

Yes, they really do. Um, I get very upset with myself. Like I said, I just sit there feeling awful afterwards... it's just really frustrating and, honestly, shameful to lose control like that. So, yes, it bothers me a lot.
After these eating episodes, do you do anything to try to make up for the eating, like fasting, exercising a lot, or using laxatives?

No, I don't do any of that. I don't fast or work out excessively, and I definitely don't use laxatives. I just... I just kind of deal with the aftermath and the guilt, but I don't try to compensate for it like that.
How often do these eating episodes happen?

For the last three months or so, it's been at least one night almost every week. Usually, I end up eating like this after an argument or if I have a late work event. And, um, some weeks it actually happens twice.
Is your weight or body shape a big part of how you judge yourself as a person?

Um, no, I wouldn't say so. I mean, I care about how I look, sure, but... it's not really how I judge myself as a person. I know I have a lot of other things going for me, like my career and my relationships. The guilt and shame I mentioned earlier, it's really just about the actual eating and losing control in the moment, not so much about my weight or body shape.
